notes: Contains no legal limits: every rating is user-entered from a plate. Packs carry terminology, guidance %, presets, glossary, sources and copy only.

Omitted as unverified on 2026-09-18: annexe, jerry can (empty), e-bike, petrol density, AU occupant default, Calor 3.9 kg / 4.5 kg butane, Thule per-size awning weights. See research/towcheck-data-pack-2026-09-18.md.
AU ball-mass band: WA DoT 8-10% of ATM chosen; NSW Government 5-10% of trailer-plus-load is an equally valid alternative (glossary).

kerb.label: Kerb mass
kerb.plate_hint: Vehicle handbook. WA DoT: running order, unoccupied, all fluids incl. full fuel, standard equipment. Manufacturer definitions vary - check whether fuel/driver are included.

gvm.label: GVM
gvm.plate_hint: Vehicle compliance plate / handbook. Max laden mass of the tow vehicle incl. occupants, load and tow-ball mass. Some cars call it MLVM.

gcm.label: GCM
gcm.plate_hint: Vehicle handbook. Max combined mass of loaded car + loaded van. Not all vehicles publish one; may be less than GVM + towing capacity.

tow_capacity.label: Max braked towing capacity
tow_capacity.plate_hint: Vehicle handbook / towbar plate. If the towbar rating is lower, the lower figure applies.

ball_max_vehicle.label: Max tow-ball download
ball_max_vehicle.plate_hint: Vehicle handbook and towbar plate. Lower of the two applies.

towbar_rating.label: Towbar rating
towbar_rating.long_name: Towbar plate: towing mass + ball mass

tare.label: Tare
tare.plate_hint: Caravan compliance plate. Empty van as delivered; water tanks empty; dealer/aftermarket extras (awning, AC, TV, extra gas) are NOT in tare.

atm.label: ATM
atm.plate_hint: Caravan compliance plate. Max total mass of the loaded van unhitched (on jockey wheel), including ball mass.

gtm.label: GTM
gtm.plate_hint: Caravan compliance plate. Max mass on the van's axles when hitched (ATM minus ball mass).

axle_group.label: Axle group rating
axle_group.plate_hint: Caravan compliance plate or axle stamp (if shown).

tbm.label: TBM
tbm.plate_hint: Measure with a ball scale or weighbridge (unhitched minus hitched car reading).

payload.label: Payload
payload.plate_hint: ATM minus tare (van); GVM minus loaded car (vehicle).

guidance.ball_mass_basis: percent of loaded caravan mass (ATM basis per WA DoT)
guidance.ball_mass_note: WA DoT: 'Tow hitch download as a guide should be 8-10% of the ATM, up to the tow bar load limit.' NSW Government states 'about 5-10 per cent of the total mass of the trailer plus load'. Your plate/towbar limits always apply.

presets.name: Fresh water tank
presets.note: approx; enter tank size in litres

presets.name: Grey water tank
presets.note: approx; usually empty when towing but fills on trip

presets.name: 9 kg gas cylinder (full)
presets.note: approx; Elgas: 16.2-18.9 kg full, tare 7.8-10.4 kg

presets.name: 4 kg / 4.5 kg gas cylinder (full)
presets.note: approx; Elgas: 8.2-10.3 kg full (3.7 kg gas)

presets.name: Mattress (each)
presets.note: Transport for NSW example: 2 x mattresses 45 kg

presets.name: Bicycle (each)
presets.note: Transport for NSW example: 2 x bicycles 30 kg

presets.name: Generator (2 kVA inverter, e.g. Honda EU22i)
presets.note: dry weight per Honda Australia; add fuel

presets.name: 100 Ah lead-acid battery
presets.note: example: Yuasa L36-100 datasheet, mean weight with acid

presets.name: Diesel top-up
presets.note: approx; AU standard density 820-850 kg/m3 at 15 C, upper bound used

glossary.definition: Aggregate Trailer Mass: total mass of the trailer when carrying the maximum load recommended by the manufacturer, including the mass imposed on the towing vehicle (VSB1 Rev 6). A plate rating, not a weighbridge reading.
Gross Trailer Mass: mass transmitted to the ground by the trailer's tyres when coupled and carrying the maximum recommended load (VSB1 Rev 6). ATM minus GTM = tow-ball down-weight at full load.
Total mass of the trailer with no load and fluid reservoirs filled (water and waste tanks excluded); includes coupling mass (VSB1 Rev 6). Aftermarket extras are payload, not tare (Transport for NSW).
ATM minus tare mass equals the maximum load the trailer can carry (VSB1 Rev 6).
Mass the coupling imposes on the tow ball. The vehicle/towbar/coupling maximum 'must not be exceeded' (Transport for NSW). Counts toward the tow vehicle's GVM (WA DoT).
Gross Vehicle Mass: maximum laden mass of the loaded motor vehicle as specified by the manufacturer; also called MLVM on some passenger vehicles (Transport for NSW).

Gross Combination Mass: maximum allowable combined mass of the loaded tow vehicle and loaded caravan hitched together, as specified by the vehicle manufacturer. 'Legally, you must not exceed the specified GCM' (Transport for NSW).
Mass of the vehicle in running order, unoccupied and unladen, fluids and fuel full, standard equipment (WA DoT). Manufacturer definitions vary.
Maximum allowable load on that axle (front or rear), as specified by the manufacturer (WA DoT).

Loaded trailer mass must not exceed the lesser of: towbar/coupling rating, vehicle maximum towing capacity, trailer capacity, tyre capacity (NSW Government). If no manufacturer figure: 1.5 x unladen mass braked, unladen mass unbraked; unbraked max 750 kg.
WA DoT: 8-10% of ATM 'as a guide'; NSW Government: 'about 5-10 per cent' of trailer plus load. Guidance, not a limit - your plate figures apply.

kerb.label: Kerbweight
kerb.plate_hint: Car handbook / V5C. Car in working order with fuel; may include 68 kg driver + 7 kg luggage - definitions vary (NCC).

gvm.label: MAM
gvm.long_name: Maximum Authorised Mass (GVW / MPW) of tow car
gvm.plate_hint: Car VIN plate line 2 / handbook. Includes noseweight when towing.

gcm.label: GTW
gcm.plate_hint: Car VIN plate line 1 / handbook. May be less than MAM + towing limit; 'must not be exceeded' (NCC).

tow_capacity.label: Max towing limit
tow_capacity.plate_hint: Car handbook / VIN plate (GTW minus MAM).

ball_max_vehicle.label: Max noseweight (car)
ball_max_vehicle.plate_hint: Car handbook. Compare with towbar S-value; the lowest of car, towbar, drawbar and hitch limits applies.

tare.label: MiRO
tare.plate_hint: Caravan weight plate / handbook. Includes standard spec; from 2011 an allowance for gas and hook-up lead; battery only if factory-fitted; water often zero from 2015 - check handbook.

atm.label: MTPLM
atm.long_name: Maximum Technically Permissible Laden Mass (caravan MAM)
atm.plate_hint: Caravan weight plate (near door or in gas locker). Absolute maximum laden weight.

gtm.label: Axle rating
gtm.plate_hint: Caravan weight plate or axle plate, if shown. Optional in GB.

ball_max_van.label: Max noseweight (hitch)
ball_max_van.plate_hint: Stamped on the hitch coupling (often 100 kg) and drawbar.

tbm.label: Noseweight
tbm.plate_hint: Measure with a noseweight gauge at towball height.

payload.label: User payload
payload.plate_hint: MTPLM minus MiRO (van); MAM minus loaded car.

guidance.ball_mass_basis: percent of actual laden caravan weight (or MTPLM if unknown)
guidance.ball_mass_note: NCC Caravan Towing Guide: noseweight 'within the 5% to 7% range of the caravan's laden weight'; Caravan and Motorhome Club: 5-7% of actual laden weight. Never above the lowest of the car, towbar, drawbar and hitch limits.
guidance.outfit_match_basis: caravan MTPLM as percent of car kerbweight
guidance.outfit_match_note: NCC: novice 'should not exceed 85%', experienced 'maximum recommended ratio is 100%'. Caravan and Motorhome Club: 85% beginners, 'perhaps up to 90%' experienced, 'Never exceed 100%'. Plate limits (MAM, GTW, MTPLM) take precedence.

presets.note: approx; enter litres carried while towing

presets.name: 6 kg propane cylinder (full)
presets.note: approx; Calor: 15-17 kg gross, tare 7.3-10.9 kg

glossary.definition: Maximum Technically Permissible Laden Mass (also Maximum Authorised Mass): 'the absolute maximum weight that the caravan must not exceed to be legal on the road', including payload, fluids and belongings (NCC).

Mass in Running Order: mass of the caravan to the manufacturer's standard specification as plated. From 2011 includes an allowance for gas bottles and hook-up cable; leisure battery only if factory-supplied; from 2015 water allowance may be zero (NCC).
The difference between MTPLM and MRO; covers personal effects and optional/dealer-fitted equipment (NCC).
Downforce the coupling head imposes on the towball, measured with a noseweight gauge; must never exceed the towbar/ball or hitch limit, whichever is lower (NCC).
Maximum vertical static load the towbar supports, on the towbar plate; the car manufacturer sets its own; 'the lowest value is the limit that must be observed' (NCC).

Weight of the car in working order with fuel and fluids; may include a 68 kg driver and 7 kg luggage allowance; definitions vary by manufacturer (NCC; Directive 95/48/EC per Camping and Caravanning Club).

Maximum Authorised Mass (Gross Vehicle Weight, Maximum Permissible Weight): maximum allowable weight of the car fully loaded, including noseweight when towing; on the VIN plate (NCC). GOV.UK: MAM is 'normally shown on a plate or sticker fitted to the vehicle or trailer'.
Gross Train Weight: maximum permitted combined mass of car and trailer per the car manufacturer; may be less than MAM + towing limit; 'must not be exceeded' (NCC).
Maximum weight of a braked trailer the car is allowed to tow (NCC). Highway Code Rule 98: 'you MUST NOT overload your vehicle or trailer' and should not tow more than the manufacturer recommends.
Industry guidance, not law: caravan MTPLM as a percentage of car kerbweight ideally not above 85% for a novice, 100% maximum for experienced (NCC). Plated limits take preference.

GOV.UK: if you got your licence from 1 January 1997 'You can tow a trailer that weighs up to 3,500kg MAM' (category BE), added to your licence automatically. DVLA INF30: 'Since 16 December 2021, if you have passed a car test (B) you can automatically drive a car with a trailer (BE)'. Pre-1997 licences: combination up to 8,250 kg MAM. Glossary only - this app does not check licence entitlement.
